title: Refactor fe_localise + update exports
objective: Refactor fe_localise.py to delegate einsum extraction to einsum_extract.py. Remove _extract_hex8_tl_einsums() private function. Update lowering/__init__.py exports.
implementation_steps: In fe_localise.py, import extract_einsum_specs from einsum_extract
In localise(), replace call to _extract_hex8_tl_einsums(n_qp, n_nodes, dim) with: specs = extract_einsum_specs(element_ir); einsum_specs = tuple(specs.values())
Run all localise/einsum/e2e tests to confirm refactoring is transparent
deliverables: fe_localise.py — slimmed by ~100 lines, delegates to einsum_extract
acceptance_criteria: localise() returns identical LocalisationResult as before refactoring
localise_and_optimize() returns identical plans as before refactoring
All pre-existing localise/einsum/e2e tests pass unchanged
risks: einsum_extract refactoring breaks localise tests. Mitigation: Logic is moved without modification. Verify by running the full test suite after the change.
